en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the owned slave, is there Zahaar upon him?’
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Half of what is upon the free, from the Fasting, and there is no expiation upon him of a charity, nor an emancipation (of a slave)’.
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from abu Hamzah al-Thumaliy who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a slave if there is expiation for al-Zihar on him.
He (the Imam) said, ‘He owes one-half of what is due on a free person of fasting, and setting free of slaves as expiation does not apply in his case as well as paying charity.’”
